name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions Datasets
description: Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions datasets contain harmonized Medicaid Analytic eXtract (MAX) and T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) inpatient admission products, including admission-level files and county/ZCTA aggregate and stratified hospitalization counts.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Harmonized Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions covering all states from 2000-2018, with cohort indicator flags (fee-for-service, dual-eligible, disabled, full-benefit) and county/ZCTA yearly and daily hospitalization and beneficiary counts (n_hosp, n_bene), overall and stratified. State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions File
description: Stay-level file of Medicaid inpatient admissions harmonized across MAX and TAF: one row per inpatient stay admitted in the year (TAF claims combined into stays with MAX's rule), restricted to beneficiaries in that year's denominator, with diagnoses, procedures, payments, DRG and discharge status.

content.bene_id: String: Unique beneficiary identifier. Source: BENE_ID.
content.year: Int32: Admission year (year of admission_date); matches the denom_yyyy.parquet cohort year this file was built against.
content.source_year: Int32: Year of the raw claims file the claim came from; usually year, but can be any year (e.g. a claim filed the year after admission). From the source file path.
content.adm_id: String: Synthetic surrogate key for the stay. For a MAX stay or a single-claim TAF stay: MD5 hash of the upstream admissions key (source_year, state, msis_id, bene_id, billing_provider_id, claim_id, admission_date, srvc_bgn_dt, srvc_end_dt; NULLs replaced by an empty string). For a combined TAF stay: MD5 of 'stay|' followed by its member claims' ids, sorted and |-joined. Stable across runs and filters. Not a source field.
content.state: String: Postal abbreviation of the state Medicaid agency that submitted the record. Source: STATE_CD.
content.msis_id: String: State-assigned unique enrollee identifier. CHAR(20) in MAX-era files, CHAR(32) in TAF-era files. Source: MSIS_ID.
content.billing_provider_id: String: State-assigned billing provider ID (not an NPI; unique only within a state, not stable across MAX to TAF). Used to combine TAF claims into stays. Source: PRVDR_ID_NMBR (MAX) / BLG_PRVDR_ID (TAF).
content.claim_ids: List[String]: TAF claim IDs in the stay, in service-date order (one element for a single-claim stay). NULL for MAX stays, which have no claim ID. Source: CLM_ID (TAF).
content.n_claims_combined: Int64: Number of TAF claims combined into this stay; 1 for MAX stays (combined by CMS, count unknown) and single-claim TAF stays.
content.srvc_bgn_dt: Date: Beginning date of service covered by the claim. May or may not equal the admission date. Source: SRVC_BGN_DT.
content.srvc_end_dt: Date: Latest date of service for any claim related to the hospital stay. May or may not be the discharge date; best used together with patient_status_cd. Source: SRVC_END_DT.
content.primary_diagnosis: String: Primary (principal) diagnosis code. Source: DIAG_CD_1 (MAX) / DGNS_CD_1 (TAF).
content.diagnoses: List[String]: Diagnosis codes. 9 elements for MAX stays, 12 for single-claim TAF stays (blank positions are NULL). For a combined TAF stay: every distinct (code, version) across its claims, first claim's codes first, so diagnoses[1] is the first claim's principal diagnosis; NULL codes dropped; can exceed 12. Source: DIAG_CD_1-9 (MAX) / DGNS_CD_1-12 (TAF).
content.diagnosis_version_cd: List[String]: Diagnosis code version per position, parallel to diagnoses. 9 = ICD-9-CM, 10 = ICD-10-CM. Missing flags are imputed from the service end date (before 2015-10-01 = ICD-9). Source: DIAG_CD_FLG_1-9 (MAX, 2012+) / DGNS_VRSN_CD_1-12 (TAF), harmonized.
content.non_external_primary: Int32: 1 if primary_diagnosis falls in the non-external-cause code range for its version (diagnosis_version_cd[1]: ICD-9 001-799, ICD-10 A00-R99); 0 otherwise.
content.non_external_all: List[Int32]: Same non-external-cause flag as non_external_primary, computed per position against diagnoses[i] using that position's own diagnosis_version_cd[i].
content.procedures: List[String]: Procedure codes, 6 elements per MAX stay / TAF claim; combined TAF stays collect every distinct (code, coding system) pair, as for diagnoses. Filter by procedure_coding_system before using. Source: PRCDR_CD_1-6.
content.procedure_coding_system: List[String]: Coding system per position, parallel to procedures. 01 = CPT-4, 02 = ICD-9-CM, 06 = HCPCS, 07 = ICD-10-PCS, 10-87 = other. Source: PRCDR_CD_SYS_1-6.
content.mdcd_cvrd_days: Int32: Medicaid-covered inpatient days (summed over a combined TAF stay's claims). MAX reports 0 for stays with a Medicare crossover claim, so 0 doesn't mean no days for dual eligibles. Source: CVRD_DAYS (MAX) / MDCD_CVRD_IP_DAYS (TAF).
content.mdcd_pymt_amt: Double: Medicaid payment amount (summed over a combined TAF stay's claims, ignoring NULLs). NULL on managed care encounter claims: TAF redacts it, and MAX's $0 placeholder on encounters (claim type 3/C) is recoded to NULL. Can be negative (credits/adjustments). Source: MDCD_PYMT_AMT (MAX) / MDCD_PD_AMT (TAF).
content.tp_pymt_amt: Double: Third-party liability amount paid (summed for combined stays). Reporting varies by state; treat as a lower bound. Source: TP_PYMT_AMT (MAX) / TP_PD_AMT (TAF).
content.mdcr_coinsur_pymt_amt: Double: Medicaid payment toward Medicare coinsurance (summed for combined stays). Redacted (NULL) on TAF encounter claims. Source: MDCR_COINSUR_PYMT_AMT (MAX) / MDCR_COINSRNC_PD_AMT (TAF).
content.mdcr_ded_pymt_amt: Double: Medicaid payment toward the Medicare deductible (summed for combined stays). Redacted (NULL) on TAF encounter claims. Source: MDCR_DED_PYMT_AMT (MAX) / MDCR_DDCTBL_PD_AMT (TAF).
content.claim_type_cd: String: Claim type (1 = FFS, 3 = managed care encounter, C = CHIP encounter, etc.); a combined TAF stay takes its last claim's. Service tracking claims (4, D, X) are excluded. Source: TYPE_CLM_CD (MAX) / CLM_TYPE_CD (TAF).
content.drg_rel_group: String: Diagnosis-related group (DRG) code. For MAX, 8-filled (8888 = DRG not used) and 9-filled (9999 = unknown) are mapped to NULL; TAF values are kept as reported. A combined TAF stay takes its last claim's. Source: DRG_REL_GROUP (MAX) / DRG_CD (TAF).
content.drg_rel_group_ind: String: Grouping system for drg_rel_group: positions 1-2 = state code, HG (CMS Grouper) or XX (other); positions 3-4 = grouper version (99 = unknown). Taken from the same claim as drg_rel_group. Source: DRG_REL_GROUP_IND (MAX) / DRG_CD_SYS (TAF).
content.patient_status_cd: String: Patient discharge status (NUBC 2-digit code); a combined TAF stay takes its last claim's. Source: PATIENT_STATUS_CD (MAX) / PTNT_DSCHRG_STUS_CD (TAF).
content.adjustment_cd: String: Harmonized adjustment status. 0 = original only, no adjustment (MAX 0, TAF 0); 1 = adjusted (MAX 1, TAF 2-6); 2 = adjustment incomplete: no original claim found, stay may be incomplete (MAX only); NULL = TAF 1 (void), missing, or unrecognized. A combined TAF stay is 1 if any of its claims was adjusted. MAX describes the set of claims combined into the stay; TAF describes the one claim, so the levels are only approximately comparable. Source: ADJUST_CD (MAX and TAF).
content.source_type: String: Which CMS file vintage the claim came from: max, taf, or max,taf when duplicate records from both were merged upstream (2014-2015 cutover years). From the source file name. Only rows that are exactly taf are combined into stays.
content.raw_filename: List[String]: Original raw CMS file(s) the record came from (all files of a combined stay, sorted).

content.Row definition: One row per inpatient stay (key: adm_id) admitted in year, restricted to beneficiaries present in that year's denom_yyyy.parquet cohort. Denominator cohort flags are not carried on this file; join to the denominator on bene_id (and year) to get them.
content.Stays: MAX rows are already stays (CMS combined the interim claims). TAF claims are combined into stays here with MAX's rule: same state, MSIS ID and billing provider, with overlapping service periods, or contiguous ones when the earlier claim's discharge status is 30 (still a patient) or missing.
content.Processing: Claims admitted in year are collected from every year's raw admissions file; service tracking claims are dropped; TAF claims are combined into stays; stays are inner-joined to the denominator on bene_id, then filtered to stays with non-missing service dates within year +/- 1.
content.Sources: Raw source fields are listed as MAX / TAF. Built from the MAX and TAF inpatient files as harmonized by harmonization-cms (ip.yaml), normalized by normalization-cms and cleaned by cleaning-cms.

name: Daily County-Level Admission Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid inpatient hospitalization counts (n_hosp__<cohort>) and beneficiary counts (n_bene__<cohort>) by cohort (e.g., n_hosp__total, n_hosp__ffs, n_bene__total, n_bene__ffs). Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.

name: Daily County-Level Stratified Admission Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid inpatient hospitalization counts (n_hosp) and beneficiary counts (n_bene) by cohort, stratified by age group, sex, race, dual status, managed care, and eligibility group. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.
